name: How does Frasheski Construction ensure proper plumbing and electrical coordination in Berkeley and the East Bay?

mainEntity.name: How does Frasheski Construction ensure proper plumbing and electrical coordination in Berkeley and the East Bay?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction prioritizes integrated planning from the project's outset. We involve our plumbing and electrical teams, or trusted subcontractors, early in the design phase to review plans collaboratively. We utilize detailed blueprints and conduct regular on-site meetings to identify and resolve potential conflicts before construction progresses. Our project managers oversee the scheduling and workflow to ensure seamless coordination between all trades, ensuring a high-quality outcome for our Berkeley and East Bay clients.
acceptedAnswer.description: Frasheski Construction ensures coordination through integrated planning, early team involvement, detailed blueprints, and regular on-site meetings.
